_doc: ADR-046 cross-repo contract-driven E2E trigger. Backend deploy green -> TriggerConsumers reads this -> if git diff hits contractGlobs, REST-queue each consumer frontend pipeline with affectedModules. Empty modules -> frontend runs @floor (L0); auto-upgrades to L1 when @module tags exist. KEEP THIS FILE PURE ASCII (Windows PS 5.1 Get-Content mis-decodes UTF-8 CJK).
